relations: 本章 Ophelia 视角；Dante 是她的 mate，约会时坐在她身旁而非对面。
她从未恋爱、从未约会；第一次 knot 是监狱之事几年后在 sex club 与记不起姓名的陌生男人完成。
Titania 是 Dante 前女友之一——共三名前女友从未停止发短信；她自称自他越狱起一直试图联系。
Dante 称她是完美 mate只是不肯承认属于他；他入狱前的交往对象毫无意义、性是预约制。

facts.fact: Dante 用意念问她第一次被谁 knot；她拒绝回答——这类问题会招杀身之祸。
facts.anchor: His mind brushed mine again. "Who knotted you the first time?"

facts.fact: 她承认监狱之事几年后决定来场性觉醒：先交友软件、后性俱乐部，knotting 是最后尝试的项目之一。
facts.anchor: A few years after the prison shit happened, I decided to have a sexual awakening.

facts.fact: Dante 坦白入狱前是个过分规矩的伴侣：性更像形式、通常预约。
facts.anchor: Before I went to prison, I was a very... respectful partner.

facts.fact: 得知有前女友从未停止发短信，她坐直追问人数；答只有三个。
facts.anchor: I sat up a little straighter. "Your exes have been texting you? How many of them?"

facts.fact: Titania 滑进卡座对面，说自他越狱起就一直在联系他。
facts.anchor: I've been trying to get in contact with you since you escaped the penitentiary," the woman gushed

facts.fact: Titania 质疑网上没有任何公告；Dante 平静答 Happily，她僵硬道贺退场。
facts.anchor: There was no announcement," she said. "Online. If you were mated, someone would've posted about it.

facts.fact: 她承认上次与人发生关系已是八十几年前，Dante 全身僵住追问是否指禁闭室口交之前。
facts.anchor: It had been that long before I went down on you in solitary confinement?" he finally asked.

facts.fact: 他宣布赌局获胜（全餐厅果然在看她），她认输并在他唇上快速一吻。
facts.anchor: I turned my head and gave him a quick kiss on the lips before sliding out from beneath his arm.
